content_sections.heading: IIT Gandhinagar Project Associate-I Job Description
content_sections.text: The institute is looking for an experienced school teacher who can deliver high-quality STEM sessions and critically evaluate how well the kits enable concept learning in real classrooms. This is a field-intensive role focused on testing and improving hands-on STEM learning kits in real classrooms and is not a conventional classroom teaching role. Core Responsibilities: Conduct live classroom sessions (Grades 6–8) using STEM kits across partner schools. Observe student thinking, responses, and misconceptions. Identify gaps in kit design, instructions, and learning flow. Capture specific classroom failures and usability issues. Translate observations into clear product improvements. Work with curriculum and product teams to refine kits. Support teacher training and demonstrations.

faq.question: Q1. What is the name of the post announced by IIT Gandhinagar?
faq.answer: Project Associate-I under the Center for Creative Learning.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for the Project Associate-I position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application is 27/10/2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the essential educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a B.C.A/B.Sc. in an appropriate discipline with a minimum of 4 years of post-qualification experience, or a B.Tech./B.E./M.Sc. or equivalent in any discipline, with a minimum of 60% from graduation onwards and 55% in class 10th and 12th.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for this post?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly remuneration is ₹45,000/- to ₹80,000/- per month depending on qualification and experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the duration of the appointment?
faq.answer: The appointment is for a duration of 1 year on a temporary basis.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee is not stated in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. How can candidates apply for this position?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the official recruitment link provided by IIT Gandhinagar.

faq.question: Q9. What are the desirable qualifications for the Project Associate-I post?
faq.answer: Preference will be given to TGT Teachers (CBSE/ICSE/State/International Board) with a minimum of 4 years of experience teaching grades 6 to 8, along with strong communication, observation, and documentation skills.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a conventional classroom teaching role?
faq.answer: No, this is a field-intensive role focused on testing and improving hands-on STEM learning kits in real classrooms rather than conventional classroom teaching.
